title: Skill editor: failed skill load leaves the previous skill's text in the editor; Save then writes it to the newly selected skill
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Library/SkillsViews.swift:167-185. load(name) only assigns content/original on success; on error (or on cancellation, see separate bead) the old skill's content/original remain while the header shows the new skill. Editing and pressing Save calls saveSkill(skill.name, content: content) -> skill B overwritten with skill A's text. Also load()'s defer clears loading when a cancelled earlier load unwinds, so the editor is briefly editable with the wrong text. Fix: clear content/original/path (and disable editing) at the start of load, on failure show an error state, and ignore results for a name that is no longer selected.

title: Model settings: changing Provider keeps the old modelID; Switch Model sends mismatched provider/model
description: Sources/HermesMac/UI/SettingsViews.swift:171-181. modelID is initialised from the current model and never reset when provider changes (no onChange(of: provider)). Pick another provider: the Model picker has no matching tag (blank), but Switch Model stays enabled because modelID is non-empty, and setModel(provider: new, model: old-provider's id) is sent. Fix: on provider change set modelID to the provider's first/default model id (or clear it).

title: No way to retry connection after a failed connect; stale chat/library state after changing settings
description: Sources/HermesMac/App/AppModel.swift:126-147, UI/SettingsViews.swift:64. connect() runs once (launch or apply). If Hermes is down at launch the badge stays 'Can't reach Hermes' forever: nothing re-checks health, Cmd-R only reloads chats and never updates connection, and Settings > Save is .disabled(draft == model.settings) so the user cannot re-apply unchanged settings; only quit/relaunch or editing a field works. Conversely a connected badge never turns red if the server dies. Also apply()/connect() does not cancel the previous connect Task (older health result can overwrite connection), and does not reset chats.selection/entries/runId/skills/jobs, so after pointing at another server the old server's chat stays open and sends to a session id that doesn't exist there. Fix: Retry button/auto-retry, periodic health, cancel+reset on apply.

title: Logs 'Follow' stops auto-scrolling once the log has >= 400 lines
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Library/AgentViews.swift:292,303. The poll asks for lines: 400 and scrolls only in .onChange(of: lines.count). Once the file has >= 400 lines the server returns exactly 400 every time (verified: /api/logs?file=agent&lines=400 -> 400 lines, lines=1000 -> 500), so count never changes and Follow never scrolls even as content shifts. Fix: onChange of lines.last (or a generation counter) and scroll to the last id. Also lines is not cleared when switching log files (stale file shown until next poll).

title: Settings > Config: failed or early load leaves an empty editable buffer; Save overwrites config.yaml
description: Sources/HermesMac/UI/SettingsViews.swift:223-226 and 215-218. .task does 'guard ..., let r = try? await c.rawConfig() else { return }' so on failure (or when the dashboard was not connected when the task ran and is configured later) yaml and original stay '' while the TextEditor is shown enabled with no error. Typing anything makes yaml != original and Save calls saveRawConfig(yaml), replacing the whole config.yaml with the typed text. Fix: surface load errors, disable the editor/Save until a successful load, re-run the task when client/hasDashboard changes.

title: Unsaved edits are silently discarded when switching skill, job, 'New Job', or section
description: SkillsViews.swift:108 (.task(id: skill.name) reloads content over the dirty buffer), JobsViews.swift:77,78,187-190 (reset()/creatingJob overwrite draft), plus view-owned @ViewState in SkillDetail/JobDetail/ConfigPane is dropped when the section changes (RootView.swift:41-50). The 'Edited' pill/dirty tracking exists but nothing guards navigation. Scenario: edit a SKILL.md, click another skill in the list -> edits gone, no prompt. Same for a half-filled job form and clicking 'New Job' or another job. Fix: hold drafts in LibraryStore keyed by id, or confirm discard when dirty.

title: Approval card is dismissed before the answer is accepted; a failed answer leaves the run blocked with no way to retry
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Chat/ChatStore.swift:184-188. answer() sets entry.approval = nil immediately, then fires answerApproval through app.run. If the call fails (network, 4xx/410), the user only gets a toast, the card is gone, and the agent run is still waiting on the approval; the stream hangs until Stop. Fix: keep the card (disabled/spinner) until the request succeeds, restore it on failure. Related: approval card is never cleared when the stream ends or is cancelled, so a stale card can still be clicked.
notes: Merged from hermes-mac-svk: also, switching chats cancels the SSE stream and Hermes interrupts the agent on client disconnect (api_server.py:3205-3215), silently killing a running turn.

title: ChatStore.select: late message load overwrites in-flight user turn (reply vanishes)
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Chat/ChatStore.swift:58-69 vs 114-121. select() fetches history asynchronously and then does entries = Self.entries(from: msgs) guarded only by selection == id. The Composer is enabled while loadingMessages is true, so on a slow server: click an existing chat, type and send quickly -> send() appends user+streaming reply entries, then the history response replaces entries wholesale; the placeholder id no longer exists so update(replyID) is a no-op and the streamed answer is invisible until the chat is reselected. Fix: disable send until history has loaded (or merge: keep entries appended after select, or ignore the response if isStreaming).

title: Markdown: loose or interrupted numbered lists all render as '1.'
description:
Sources/HermesMac/UI/Markdown.swift:39,46,105. parse() flushes the numbered run on every blank line or interleaved bullet, and MarkdownView numbers each run with enumerated offset n+1 (never the source number). Verified by running parse(): '1. alpha

2. beta

3. gamma' -> three separate numbered([x]) blocks, each rendered '1.'; '1. a
   - sub
2. b' -> numbered, bullet, numbered (second shows '1.'); '3. three
4. four' renders 1,2. Loose lists and lists with nested bullets/code are very common LLM output. Fix: keep the first item's number as start, treat blank line followed by another numbered item as the same list, and attach indented sub-items to the previous item.

title: pump() can run twice: pumping flag is set inside the Task, so back-to-back enqueue() spawns two pumps
description: VoiceController.swift enqueue(): `if !pumping { Task { await pump() } }` but pumping=true is only set when pump starts running (after main actor yields). Two enqueue calls in one main-actor run both see pumping==false. Realistic: ChatStore.send calls onEvent(last delta) then onFinish immediately with no suspension (ChatStore.swift:135-144), so last delta yielding a sentence + flush() enqueue twice; also several buffered SSE events. Result: two pumps share queue, render concurrently, sentences can play out of order, and the first to finish sets pumping=false/settle() (mic open, phase listening) while the other still speaks. Fix: set pumping=true synchronously in enqueue before spawning.

title: Second voice utterance silently dropped while first turn is starting (runId nil), and splitter reset
description: VoiceController.transcribeAndSend ~L205-230: steer branch requires chats.isStreaming && chats.runId != nil. isStreaming is streamTask != nil (ChatStore.swift:29) and is true from send() onward, but runId is only set on run.started (after createSession/connect). If a 2nd utterance finishes transcribing in that window (VAD ends at 1.1s pause so split sentences are common), it skips steer, does phase=.thinking, splitter = SentenceSplitter() (wiping the first reply's partial buffer) then chats.send() hits guard !isStreaming and returns silently: the user's words are lost with no feedback. Fix: if chats.isStreaming but runId nil, wait for runId (or queue the text) instead of calling send; never reset splitter unless send is accepted.

title: Stale 1s pre-roll audio from before mute / non-AEC speaking is prepended to next utterance
description: VoiceController.swift FrameProcessor.setListening(false) resets vad and utterance but not preroll. process() returns before appending to preroll while !listening, so the ring buffer keeps the last ~1s captured before the mute. On unmute the next .start does utterance = preroll.flatMap, sending audio from before the mute (e.g. words said just before hitting mute) to STT/Hermes; also the TTS-time closure in non-AEC mode. Fix: preroll.removeAll() in setListening(false) (and vad hist reset).

title: Voice speed slider ignored: VoicePrefs.rate reads Float but AppStorage stores Double
description: VoiceController.swift:~27 `UserDefaults.object(forKey:"voice.rate") as? Float ?? 0.52`; SettingsViews.swift:83 stores Double via @AppStorage. NSNumber(Double) bridges to Float only when exactly representable. Verified in scratch: 0.6, 0.52, 0.45 -> nil (falls back to 0.52); only 0.5 works. So Settings>Voice>Speed has no effect in real voice mode (the preview uses Float(rate) directly so it sounds right there). Fix: use UserDefaults.standard.double/float(forKey:) with a presence check.

title: Job edit re-sends schedule.display as schedule: one-shot jobs cannot be edited
description: HermesClient.swift:195 JobDraft.init(CronJob) seeds schedule from schedule.display; body (198-201) PATCHes it back on every updateJob. cron/jobs.py parse_schedule rejects one-shot displays: 'once at 2026-11-22 14:00' / 'once in 30m' match no branch (no 'T', not starting with digits) => ValueError => 400, so even renaming a one-shot job fails; also display can be lossy vs expr. Fix: only send schedule when user changed it (or send run_at ISO / expr for kind cron/once). Also repeat/timezone nil are dropped by compactMapValues (HTTP.swift:99) so PATCH can never clear repeat count or timezone.

title: messages() uses order=oldest limit=500: sessions with >500 messages show only the oldest 500
description: HermesClient.swift:60-63 sends limit=500&order=oldest, no offset paging. Server (api_server.py:2722-2750) caps limit at 500 and returns the first 500 rows for order=oldest; default/order=latest returns the LAST 500 (verified with curl: order=latest&limit=2 returns the newest 2 ids in ascending order). So opening a long chat shows a stale prefix and the latest turns are missing, and new replies appear to continue from nowhere. Fix: omit order (or order=latest) and page backwards with offset if more are needed. Related: sessions() ignores has_more (ChatStore.reload limit=200, server max 200) so chats beyond 200 are silently unreachable.

title: Stop button's delayed cancelStream() kills the next turn sent within 2s
description: ChatStore.swift:171-176 stop(): spawns Task{sleep 2s; cancelStream()} unconditionally. Scenario: user (or voice barge-in) hits Stop at t0; server emits run.cancelled at ~0.3s so streamTask finishes; user sends a new message at t=1s (streamTask = new Task); at t=2s the stale sleep task calls cancelStream() which cancels the NEW stream, nulls runId, and the server interrupts the new run (api_server.py _drain_session_stream_task_on_disconnect interrupts agent on disconnect). Fix: capture the task identity in stop() and only cancel if streamTask is still that task (or store/cancel the sleeper when the stream ends).

title: Upstream Hermes: GET /v1/skills always 500 (find_all_skills() got unexpected kwarg include_editorial)
description: gateway/platforms/api_server.py:2391 _handle_skills calls find_all_skills(skip_disabled=False, include_editorial=True); tools/skills_tool.find_all_skills has no include_editorial param on hermes-agent main @52b5271. Client works around it by using dashboard GET /api/skills. Needs upstream issue/PR to NousResearch/hermes-agent (outward-facing: confirm with jmtech first).
notes: 2026-11-21: patched locally (patches/hermes-agent-v1-skills.patch, auto-applied by scripts/dev-hermes.sh); verified 44 skills returned. jmtech: do NOT file upstream yet - ask him again later before opening the NousResearch issue/PR.

title: New Skill: description with a backslash produces invalid YAML front matter; skills filter is case-sensitive on name
description: SkillsViews.swift:232: only double quotes are replaced inside description: "..."; a backslash (e.g. regex or Windows path) becomes an invalid/changed YAML escape in a double-quoted scalar, breaking the skill's front matter. SkillsViews.swift:39: $0.name.contains(q) with q lowercased, so names containing capitals never match the filter. Fix: escape backslashes (or use a block scalar) and lowercase name.

title: Keychain.set deletes the existing item before adding and ignores the SecItemAdd result
description: Sources/HermesMac/App/AppModel.swift:16-23. If SecItemAdd fails (locked/denied keychain, rebuilt ad-hoc binary ACL prompt denied) the old key is already gone, apply() proceeds as if saved, and next launch the app is unconfigured with no message. Fix: SecItemUpdate first / add-then-delete, check OSStatus and flash on failure.

title: Chat auto-scroll yanks to bottom on every streamed delta even if the user scrolled up
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Chat/ChatViews.swift:142. .onChange(of: chats.entries.last?.text) { scrollTo bottom } is unconditional, so during a long answer the user cannot scroll up to read earlier text. Fix: track whether the viewport is at the bottom (onScrollGeometryChange) and only follow then.

title: Usage pane shows previous period's report (and keeps it on failure) after changing the range
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Library/AgentViews.swift:228-231. report is never cleared when usageDays changes, so '30 days' is labelled while 7-day numbers are shown until the request returns; on failure the stale numbers stay with only a 3 s toast. Fix: set report = nil (spinner) at task start, show an error state.

title: Memory 'Forget' confirmation doesn't say what will be erased
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Library/AgentViews.swift:117-119,141-146. Three buttons (Forget Memories / Profile / Everything) share one confirmationDialog titled "This can't be undone." with a bare 'Forget' button, so the user can't tell which scope they are confirming. Fix: title/message/button built from confirm (e.g. 'Forget everything?').

title: dev-hermes.sh: patch failure is silent and 'up' check can pass against a different server on :8642/:9119
description: scripts/dev-hermes.sh:23-25 'git apply --check ... 2>/dev/null; if ok apply' conflates 'already applied' with 'does not apply (checkout drifted)'; in the latter case it silently starts unpatched Hermes (hermes-mac-6eg bug) and it also mutates the user's HERMES_SRC working tree without notice. Lines 52-58: readiness only checks HTTP 200 on /health of fixed ports; if another Hermes (e.g. the user's real ~/.hermes instance) already holds 8642/9119 the new tmux session fails to bind but the script prints 'Hermes dev up' and the app talks to the wrong server. Fix: distinguish applied/failed (git apply --reverse --check), warn; check ports are free before starting.

title: Info.plist NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=true globally while the API key is sent as a Bearer header; no warning for non-local http URLs
description: Resources/Info.plist:21-24. Arbitrary loads disables ATS for every connection (NSAllowsLocalNetworking is then redundant). ConnectionSettings accepts any URL (AppModel.swift:58), so a user can enter http://public-host:8642 and the API key / dashboard token go out in cleartext with no UI warning. Suggest: drop NSAllowsArbitraryLoads, keep NSAllowsLocalNetworking, add NSExceptionDomains for tailnet hosts or warn in ConnectionForm when scheme is http and host is not loopback/private/.ts.net.

title: Cmd-R 'Reload' always reloads chats, even in Skills/Scheduled/Tools/etc.
description: Sources/HermesMac/App/HermesApp.swift:29. The Conversation > Reload command calls chats.reload() regardless of model.section, while every other section has its own refresh (.refreshable / loadX). In Skills, Cmd-R silently refreshes the hidden chat list and the visible list stays stale. Fix: dispatch by section.

title: Spurious 'cancelled' error toasts when switching skill / usage period quickly
description: SkillsViews.swift:173 (load) and AgentViews.swift:230 (usage) catch every error and flash it. .task(id:) cancels the in-flight request on a quick re-selection; HermesKit does not filter cancellation (no CancellationError/URLError.cancelled handling in Endpoint), so the user gets 'Couldn't open X: cancelled'. Fix: ignore CancellationError and URLError.cancelled in those catch blocks (or in AppModel.flash path).

title: Errors swallowed with try?/catch-to-empty instead of going through flash (project rule)
description: ChatStore.swift:232 runSearch catch -> searchHits = [] (search failure looks like 'No matches'); JobsViews.swift:194 loadRuns try? -> history silently empty; LibraryStore.swift:48 deliveryTargets try? -> falls back to Local only with no message (saved deliver targets still shown but picker incomplete); AgentViews.swift:303 Logs poll try? -> stale lines forever when server is down; SettingsViews.swift:187-188 ModelPane modelInfo/modelOptions try? -> blank pane. Each should flash (rate-limited for polling) or show an inline error state.
notes: Merged from hermes-mac-7is: runSearch, jobRuns, modelOptions swallow errors too.

title: ChatStore.stop(): 2 s delayed cancelStream() kills whatever stream is running then, including a new turn
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Chat/ChatStore.swift:171-176. stop() schedules Task{sleep 2; cancelStream()} with no check that it is still the same stream. Press Stop, then send a new message within 2 s (the server cancels fast, so isStreaming flips false and the composer re-enables): the delayed cancelStream() cancels the new turn and clears runId. Fix: capture the streamTask identity (or runId) and only cancel if unchanged.
close_reason: duplicate of hermes-mac-n2b (same delayed cancelStream in stop())

title: ChatStore.select: history load failure is sticky (loadedFor set) and shows the 'Good morning' Greeting for a real chat
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Chat/ChatStore.swift:53-69, ChatViews.swift:128. loadedFor = id is set before the fetch, so after a failed messages() call re-clicking the same chat is a no-op (guard id != loadedFor) and ConversationView shows Greeting (entries empty, not loading) with only a 3 s toast. Also the cancelled first load's defer clears loadingMessages while a second select's load is still running (flicker to Greeting). Fix: set loadedFor only on success, show an error/retry state, and only clear loadingMessages if selection == id.

title: Markdown: nested lists flatten, an inner fence line closes a code block, tables need a preceding blank line
description:
Sources/HermesMac/UI/Markdown.swift:32,34,40. (1) line is trimmed before list detection so '- a
  - nested
- b' -> bullet([a, nested, b]) (indent lost). (2) any line with prefix three backticks inside a fence closes it: '```python
x=1
```js
y
```' -> code(x=1), paragraph(y), empty code block; four-backtick and tilde fences unsupported. (3) 'text
| a | b |
|---|---|' (table straight after a paragraph line) stays one paragraph because table rows are only collected when para is empty. Verified by running the extracted parse(). Perf is fine (218 KB parse+inline = 124 ms).

title: Settings voice preview starts a full mic-capturing engine just to play audio
description: SettingsViews.swift VoicePane.preview(): VoiceAudio.start installs an input tap, so previewing a voice triggers the mic indicator/permission and fails with 'No usable microphone input' (or mic denied) even though only playback is needed; also spins up a second engine alongside live voice mode. Fix: playback-only start path (no input tap) or AVAudioPlayer for preview.

title: Steer-fallback timeout reported as STT failure and user's words dropped
description: VoiceController.transcribeAndSend: after steer refusal, if the turn is still streaming after 10s, `throw error` lands in the outer catch which logs [VOX-STT-ERR] 'stt failed', plays nothingUsable earcon and settles. The recognized text is discarded and nothing user-visible says so (project rule: surface failures via AppModel.run/flash). Fix: distinct log code and surface a message / keep text in heard+queue.

title: Esc during VoiceController.start() (.starting) is ignored: mic goes live afterwards
description: VoiceController.start(): Task awaits AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess (first-run prompt can take long), then unconditionally configureEngines/makeAudio and sets phase=.listening. stop() during .starting only sets phase=.off (audio nil), so the pending task still starts the engine and mic. Fix: capture generation (or check phase==.starting) after the await and bail if changed.

title: SentenceSplitter fragments on abbreviations/list numbers and speaks code fences; strips underscores
description: VAD.swift SentenceSplitter (regex copied from drive-mode say()). Verified in scratch: 'Dr. Smith said e.g. this works.' -> 'Dr.' / 'Smith said e.g.' / 'this works.'; '1. First item\n2. Second' -> 'See 1.' / 'First item' / '2.'; each fragment is a separate TTS render with prosody breaks and gaps. Fenced code is read aloud ('python', 'myvar = a  b'), snake_case and URL underscores are mangled ('my_var'->'myvar'). Same as reference but worse in a chat client where replies contain code/lists. Fix: skip splits after known abbreviations / lone digits+period, drop fenced blocks, only strip emphasis underscores.

title: settle() re-opens mic between sentences without AEC (ignores canListen)
description: VoiceController.settle(): `frames.setListening(!muted)` ignores canListen. When pump drains the queue while the stream is still going (TTS faster than the model, normal), settle() runs with audio.echoCancelling==false and opens the VAD during the gap; the speaker tail/room echo can trigger .start -> phase .hearing, then next sentence sets .speaking and resets VAD, dropping it. Fix: use !muted && canListen (and recompute canListen after phase set).

title: Answering approval clears UI before the request succeeds; chat switch interrupts running turn silently
description: (1) ChatStore.swift:184-188 answer() sets entry.approval=nil before answerApproval completes; on 409 approval_not_pending / network error the toast shows but the card is gone and the run stays blocked on approval with no way to retry. Restore the approval on failure. (2) select()/newChat() (ChatStore.swift:54,106) cancel the SSE task; server interrupts the live agent on client disconnect (api_server.py:3205-3215), so merely clicking another chat kills the running turn with no warning or runId stop; consider confirming or keeping the stream.
close_reason: duplicate of hermes-mac-1ll (approval card cleared before answer succeeds); chat-switch note merged there

title: Keychain.set ignores OSStatus; failed save still reports connected settings
description: AppModel.swift:16-23: SecItemDelete then SecItemAdd with no status check and no kSecAttrAccessible; if the add fails (locked/denied/duplicate race) the old secret is already deleted, the UI thinks settings saved, and next launch is unconfigured with no message. Fix: SecItemUpdate-or-add, check status, surface via flash/log with [CODE].

title: AppModel.connect: no cancellation of prior connect and stale chat state kept across server change
description: AppModel.swift:132-147: each apply()/connect() spawns an unstructured Task; two quick Apply clicks race and the older health result can overwrite connection state; the previous client is not told to stop. ChatStore.selection/entries/sessions/runId from the old server are never reset when settings change (or health fails), so send() posts the old session id to the new server (404/permission error) and stale chats remain listed. Fix: keep/cancel a connectTask, compare client identity before writing state, and call chats.newChat()+clear sessions on apply.

title: Swallowed errors violate every-failure-surfaces rule (runSearch, jobRuns, modelOptions)
description: ChatStore.swift:232 runSearch catch{searchHits=[]} (dashboard error looks like 'no results'); JobsViews.swift:194 'try? c.jobRuns' (failed fetch shows empty run history); SettingsViews.swift:188 'try? modelOptions'. Route through app.flash / inline error state.

title: Query values: '+' not encoded, server decodes it as space (search, logs, skill name)
description: HTTP.swift:71-72 uses URLQueryItem; URLComponents leaves '+' literal (verified: value 'a+b&c' -> name=a+b%26c). aiohttp/FastAPI decode '+' as space, so searching 'c++' or a skill/log query containing '+' sends the wrong text. Fix: build percentEncodedQuery with .urlQueryAllowed minus '+&=' .

title: Path component double percent-encoding in HTTPCore.request (HermesClient.path + URLComponents.path)
description: HermesClient.swift:25 pre-encodes ids; HTTP.swift:70 assigns the result to URLComponents.path which encodes '%' again. Verified with swiftc: id 'a%2Fb c' -> /api/sessions/a%25252Fb%2520c. Any id containing space or other reserved char (externally created session, toolset name, etc.) hits the wrong resource (404). Fix: set comps.percentEncodedPath, or pass raw ids to comps.path without pre-encoding (and reject '/' ids).

title: ChatStore.send tail clobbers streamTask/runId of a newer stream after cancel
description: ChatStore.swift:141-145: the Task body always does streamTask = nil; runId = nil after the loop, even when cancelStream()/newChat()/select() already replaced streamTask with a newer send(). Scenario: send A, newChat() (cancelStream nils streamTask), send B immediately (new streamTask), old task A resumes from cancellation on MainActor and sets streamTask=nil/runId=nil => isStreaming false while B streams: Stop button vanishes, a 2nd send() passes the !isStreaming guard and POSTs a concurrent turn to the same session, and voice steer (needs runId) is skipped. Fix: generation token; only clear if streamTask still belongs to this task. Also reload() runs from the dead task.

title: swift build -c release (all targets) fails: hermes-checks can't resolve HermesKit module
description: Seen 2026-11-22: 'swift build -c release' errors 'unable to resolve Swift module dependency to a compatible module: HermesKit' for hermes-checks under CLT-only toolchain. scripts/build.sh (--product HermesMac) and debug 'swift run hermes-checks' work, so nothing ships broken; investigate (likely CLT release-mode module cache).

title: Markdown links show no target: [https://apple.com](https://evil.example) is indistinguishable from a real link
description: Sources/HermesMac/UI/Markdown.swift:67-74. The scheme allowlist works (http/https/mailto), but link text can name a different host than the href, and there is no hover/confirm. Model output influenced by prompt injection can phish. Suggest showing the host on hover or confirming when text looks like a URL that differs from href.

title: Jobs: Repeat picker lacks the job's actual value; replace() leaves list unsorted
description: JobsViews.swift:125-128: tags are only 0,1,2,3,5,10,25; a job with repeat.times=4 gives an invalid Picker selection (blank, console warning) and Save re-sends it. LibraryStore.swift:52-54 replace() appends/updates in place so renamed or newly created jobs are out of the name-sorted order until the next loadJobs.

title: Accessibility: icon-only and empty-label controls
description: ChatViews.swift:347-360 composer Stop/Voice/Send buttons rely on .help only (no accessibilityLabel); ToolChips state icons (ChatViews:272-274) have no label; JobsViews.swift:115 remove-skill xmark button unlabeled; AgentViews.swift:22-25 toolset Toggle("") with labelsHidden has no accessible name (VoiceOver can't tell which toolset); TypingIndicator ignores reduce-motion.

title: Voice tooltips say shift-cmd-V but the shortcut is option-cmd-V
description: Sources/HermesMac/Features/Chat/ChatViews.swift:155 and :355 (.help "Voice mode (⇧⌘V)") vs HermesApp.swift:25 keyboardShortcut("v", modifiers: [.command, .option]).
